title: A thought experiment: emancipating a remotely piloted drone

statements.text: Frankish and Dennett sketch the design of an autonomous drone made by moving a human pilot’s controls into the drone, with simpler surrogate representation-users that achieve the same control with less comprehension and no consciousness. The goal is a drone that can report what it is like to be it, which needs it to notice its own noticing. The project is a thought experiment, not built.

sources.quote: We are looking at the task of taking a military drone, controlled remotely by a human pilot, and emancipating it
We want our robot drone to be able to tell us what it is like to be it
